basis: Native and public logs for omitted RANDOMIZE are byte-identical to their existing literal RANDOMIZE 0 references across two repeated runs, including the complete 625-slot state dump.

A dynamic helper returns seed 1234 exactly once in each engine/run; after the RNG is disturbed, reinitialization restores all 625 state elements to the pre-disturbance state. Native/public logs are byte-identical in both runs.
The source registration, nullable integer-expression builder, runtime handler and seed-to-generator handoff were checked against fixed v24 source member hashes.
limitations: Only omitted seed equivalence to literal zero and one dynamic helper returning existing seed 1234 are covered; this is not a proof over all seeds, invalid expressions, or parser forms.
Native process natural exit was not observed; the owned isolated-desktop runner cleaned up each process.
The separate RAND expression, RANDOM method-as-command, DUMPRAND and INITRAND targets retain their own scope and statuses.
